parameters.query:
SELECT 
  id, 
  customer_name, 
  customer_email, 
  company_name, 
  items, 
  subtotal, 
  discount_percent, 
  total_amount, 
  created_at
FROM quotations
WHERE id = '{{ $json.quote_id }}'::uuid
LIMIT 1;

UPDATE quotations
SET pdf_status = '{{ $json.action }}'
WHERE id = '{{ $json.id }}'::uuid
RETURNING id, customer_name, total_amount;
